description: treg is a hosted tool catalog and credential-injecting proxy for AI agents and teams. It lets users call catalogued third-party endpoints and their own registered tools through one base URL while holding provider credentials server-side.
summary: treg.to exposes one REST HTTP API at https://treg.to, one OAuth-protected MCP server at https://treg.to/mcp/, and a `treg` CLI; HTTP uses `X-Treg-Token`, while MCP accepts either `Authorization: Bearer` with a treg token or OAuth self-onboarding via DCR.
